title: 第20章 再遇女尸第21章 遗留的信封
content_zh:
：时间很快就过去了，我已经从医院走了出来，其中赵史也来看过我，可每当我向他问起刘倩倩在哪的时候，他总会搪塞过去。
对此我也并没有再次询问，毕竟人家肯定有人家要忙的事情。
出了医院走到大街上，阳光照射在我的脸颊，感到如此温暖，看着街上人来人往的众人和卡里的十万块钱，我决定了，要去天上人间消费！
“师傅，去天上人间！”
我随手拦了一辆出租车，便前往了按摩娱乐中心，很快就到达了娱乐城
很快司机是否一个甩尾便到了天上人间的楼下，我看了看手中的十万块钱，内心早已躁动不安，急忙的冲了上去。
上去之后点了一个九九九的套餐，我一脸悠闲的躺在椅上，面前给我服侍的小姐，进来了一批又一批，任我挑选，没过多久，我便挑选了一个样貌，身材极为高挑的女子。
女子听了之后点了点头，便开始为我洗脚，我的身体也逐渐变得燥热起来，毕竟谁来洗脚，只是单纯的为了洗脚。
女子也是极为了解我，疯狂迎合我的需求，就在我即将上垒的时候。
“啊！”
旁边突然传来一声惨叫！
瞬间把我吓得没有力气，我顿时火冒三丈！
从按摩床上下来，敲响了对面的房门，开门的是一名女性，面容精致，不过嘴角带有些许的红色血迹，疯狂的舔拭嘴角。
我看了之后冷汗直流，女人淡淡的摇了摇头问道：“怎么了吗？有事吗？”
我听了之后，恨不得转身就跑，不过只能强装镇定说道：“没…没事，就是走错了房门，我现在就走！”
就在我回头直接用余光瞟了瞟房间里面，一个中年肥肚男的尸体横躺在地，地下全是血迹，而脑袋已不在头上。
我吓得恨不得拔腿就跑，就在这时女人抓住了我的肩膀，用力一捏，我整个肩膀疼痛的叫了起来。
女人看着我露出诡异的表情说道：“你是不是看见了？如果看见了的话就留在这吧！”
就在这时，女人脸上的皮肤开始脱落，瞬间露出血盆大口，一口朝我脑袋咬了过来！
千钧一发之际，我身体的肾上腺素疯狂飙升，一脚踢飞了女人，桃木剑我也没有随身携带，只能飞快的往楼下奔去，先行撤退。

就在我即将向后跑去的时候，我的房间门开了，帮我按摩的小姐看我这么久没回来，正好迎面撞向，准备逃跑的我。
吓得我急忙躲闪，往旁边飞快的加速跑了下去，而身后的女人放弃了追逐我的想法，露出血盆大口，一口朝按摩小姐咬了过去！
身后传来按摩小姐凄惨的叫声，可是我并不敢回头，我现在只有一个想法，逃离逃得越远越好！
很快，我便从三楼一口气跑了下来，前台看我跑得如此急切，礼貌的询问：“先生不要跑太快，注意点，脚下别滑倒了。”
我头也不回的飞快，从她身边跑过，不过就在即将出去的时候，我转头说一句：“听我一句劝，赶快离开这！”
说完我直接跑了，只留下前台一脸茫然的站在原地。
content_en:
: Time passed quickly and I had already walked out of the hospital. Zhao Shi also came to see me, but whenever I asked him where Liu Qianqian was, he would always prevaricate.
I didn't ask again about this, after all, someone must be busy with something.
After leaving the hospital and walking to the street, the sun shone on my cheeks and I felt so warm. Looking at the people passing by on the street and the 100,000 yuan in my card, I decided to go spend it in heaven and on earth!
"Master, go to heaven and earth!"
I hailed a taxi and went to the massage and entertainment center, and soon arrived at the entertainment city
Soon the driver swerved and arrived at the downstairs of Heaven and Earth. I looked at the 100,000 yuan in my hand. I was already restless and rushed up.
After I went up, I ordered a 999 set meal, and I lay down on the chair with a leisurely look. The ladies who were waiting for me came in batch after batch, letting me choose. It didn't take long for me to choose a woman with an extremely tall appearance.
After hearing this, the woman nodded and began to wash my feet. My body gradually became hot. After all, who washes my feet is just for the sake of washing my feet.
The woman also knew me extremely well and catered to my needs like crazy, just when I was about to hit the bat.
"Ah!"
Suddenly there was a scream from the side!
I was instantly frightened to the point of losing all my energy, and I suddenly became furious!
She got off the massage table and knocked on the door opposite. The person who opened the door was a woman with a delicate face, but there was a little red blood at the corner of her mouth, and she was licking her mouth frantically.
I broke into a cold sweat after watching it. The woman shook her head lightly and asked, "What's wrong? Is something wrong?"
After hearing this, I wanted to turn around and run away, but I could only pretend to be calm and said: "No...it's okay, I just walked into the wrong door. I'm leaving now!"
Just when I turned around and glanced inside the room with my peripheral vision, I saw the body of a middle-aged man with a fat belly lying on the ground. The ground was covered in blood, but his head was no longer on his head.
I was so frightened that I wanted to run away. At this moment, the woman grabbed my shoulder and squeezed it hard. My whole shoulder screamed in pain.
The woman looked at me with a strange expression and said, "Did you see it? If you saw it, just stay here!"
At this moment, the skin on the woman's face began to peel off, revealing her bloody mouth and biting my head!
At the critical moment, the adrenaline in my body surged wildly, and I kicked the woman away. I didn't carry the mahogany sword with me, so I could only run downstairs quickly and retreat first.
Just when I was about to run back, the door to my room opened. The girl who was doing my massage saw that I hadn't been back for so long, so she bumped into me and was about to run away.
I was so frightened that I hurriedly dodged and ran quickly to the side. The woman behind me gave up the idea of ​​chasing me, exposed her bloody mouth, and bit the massage girl!
The miserable screams of the massage girl came from behind me, but I didn't dare to look back. I only had one idea now, run away as far away as possible!
Soon, I ran down from the third floor in one breath. The front desk saw that I was running so eagerly and asked politely: "Sir, don't run too fast. Be careful and don't slip under your feet."
I ran past her quickly without looking back, but just as I was about to go out, I turned around and said, "Listen to my advice and get out of here!"
After saying that, I ran away directly, leaving the receptionist standing there with a blank look on his face.
